name: Distracting Spellstrike
text:
Requirements You have a hand free, and your Spellstrike is charged.

---
You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike. Make a Spellstrike and feint traits=arcane,visual against the target of your Strike. Execute your Feint immediately before making the Strike, but after choosing your target. The Feint gains the arcane and visual traits, and it always has the basic effects of a Feint, rather than applying any adjustments or alternate effects from other feats or abilities.

If you're in the Arcane Cascade stance, you gain a status bonus to your Deception check equal to your extra damage from Arcane Cascade (typically 1, increasing to 2 if you have weapon specialization and 3 if you have greater weapon specialization).
